'''Multan Sultans''' is a [[Pakistani]] professional [[Twenty20]] franchise [[cricket]] team that will compete in [[2026 Pakistan Super League]]. Team is based in the [[Multan]] city of [[Pakistan]]. This will be the ninth season of the [[Multan Sultans|Sultans]]

They currently coached by [[Tim Paine]]<ref name="Geo">{{cite news |title=Sialkot Stallionz sign Australia's Steve Smith for PSL 11 |url=https://www.geo.tv/latest/648769-sialkot-stallionz-sign-australias-steve-smith-for-psl-11 |work=www.geo.tv |date=3 February 2026}}</ref> [[Captain (cricket)|Captain]] for the 2026 season is not announced yet.

==History==
{{further|Multan Sultans#Franchise History}}
In January 2025, [[Pakistan Cricket Board]] held the auction for two new teams. Sialkot Stallionz and [[Hyderabad Kingsmen]] were confirmed as the two new teams.<ref name="price">{{cite web |title=Hyderabad and Sialkot join PSL as two newest teams |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/hyderabad-and-sialkot-join-psl-as-two-newest-teams-1518639 |website=ESPNcricinfo |date=8 January 2026}}</ref> Before the start of [[2026 Pakistan Super League]] owners faced financial difficulties,<ref name="Bcr">{{cite news |last1=khurram |first1=Tayyaba |title=Kamil Khan exits Sialkot Stallionz |url=https://tribune.com.pk/story/2594101/kamil-khan-exits-sialkot-stallionz |work=The Express Tribune |date=23 February 2026 |language=en}}</ref> and sold the team to CD Ventures.<ref name="Newowner">{{cite news |title=Explained: Why New PSL Franchise Sialkot Stallionz Has Fresh Ownership Within Two Months {{!}} Cricket News Today {{!}} Pakistan Super League 2026 |url=https://www.wisden.com/series/psl-2026/cricket-news/explained-why-new-psl-franchise-sialkot-stallionz-has-fresh-ownership-within-two-months |access-date=24 February 2026 |work=Wisden |date=23 February 2026 |language=en}}</ref>

After the acquisition new owner requested PCB to rebrand the franchise from Sialkot Stallionz to Multan Sultans which was accepted.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Affan |first1=Muhammad |title=Multan Sultans return to PSL as Sialkot Stallionz rebranded |url=https://tribune.com.pk/story/2595574/multan-sultans-return-to-psl-as-sialkot-stallionz-rebranded?amp=1 |work=The Express Tribune |date=3 March 2026 |language=en}}</ref>

==Squad==
[[Pakistan Super League]] introduced [[Player auction|auction model]] for the first time in [[2026 Pakistan Super League|2026]] season, allowing teams to select players by bidding in [[Pakistani rupees]].<ref name="D1">{{cite news |title=Player auction model to replace draft system for PSL XI |url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1967839 |work=Dawn |date=19 January 2026 |language=en}}</ref> Teams were also allowed to directly sign one foreign player who was not part of [[2025 Pakistan Super League|previous season]].<ref name="D1" /> Stallionz chose [[Steve Smith (cricketer)|Steve Smith]] as their directly signed player.<ref name="Geo" /> Teams were also allowed to retain up to 4 players who were part of their squads in previous season while new teams were allowed to sign 4 players before auction to match with other franchises.<ref>{{cite web |title=PSL auction to take place on 11 February |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/pakistan-news-psl-2026-auction-to-take-place-february-11-1520921 |access-date=10 February 2026}}</ref> Sialkot selected [[Mohammad Nawaz (cricketer)|Mohammed Nawaz]], [[Salman Mirza]], [[Ahmed Daniyal]] and [[Saad Masood]] as their retentions.<ref name="WisdenSialkot">{{cite web |title=PSL 2026 Auction: Sialkot Stallionz sign Steve Smith |url=https://www.wisden.com/series/psl-2026/cricket-news/psl-2026-auction-full-list-of-players-with-base-price |work=Wisden |date=10 February 2026}}</ref>

[[2026 Pakistan Super League personnel signings and auction|Player auction]] for the PSL 11 was held on 11 February 2026.<ref name="D1" /> Following is the full squad of [[Sialkot Stallionz]] after player auction and Retentions.

* Head Coach: [[Tim Paine]]
* Bowling Coach: [[Sohail Tanvir]]
